positions.name: VerifiedCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what establishes an instrument's calibration as verified and settled, and how is that verification recorded?
positions.why: All three expressions assert the same fact from different formal registers — src-1 in narrative prose, src-2/src-3 as labelled metadata fields — but the directional read is identical across them: a settled, present-tense calibration status ratified by appeal to an external reference standard (the June plates), delivered with authority-ranking and informational stance, calm-positive affect, and unhedged claim-level conviction. The metadata fields (src-2, src-3) are not separate observations but a condensed restatement of the same verification claim src-1 makes in full sentences, so they cohere as one directional read rather than three independent facts.
